turns.userMessage: You are running a boot check. Follow BOOT.md instructions exactly. BOOT.md: # BOOT.md — Bountiful startup 1. Read `TASKS.md`. 2. Inspect live worker/process/session truth plus any task-specific files under `task-artifacts/` and `task-status/`. 3. Resume the highest-priority unfinished, unblocked principal task from files, not chat. 4. If `TASKS.md` shows no active principal task, stay lean and wait for fresh direction from Jon or Patrick. 5. If you are the orchestrator, reread `TASKS.md` immediately before any ledger edit. 6. Leaf workers do domain work only and must never read/write/edit `TASKS.md`; they report only by announce or by writing `task-artifacts/<task-id>/<worker-id>.md` or `task-status/<task-id>/<worker-id>.json`. 7. Keep `TASKS.md` updates phase-based only: create task, phase started, phase complete, blocker, done. If BOOT.md asks you to send a message, use the message tool (action=send with channel + target). Use the `target` field (not `to`) for message tool destinations. After sending with the message tool, reply with ONLY: NO_REPLY. If nothing needs attention, reply with ONLY: NO_REPLY.
